Home.title: Welcome to Fruttata Exports
Home.description: Bringing Ecuador's agricultural richness to international markets. At Fruttata Exports, we are an Ecuadorian company specializing in the export of high-quality tropical and exotic fruits. We connect the richness of our agricultural production with international markets.
Home.originDescription: Products sourced from Ecuador's rich agricultural heritage.
Home.sustainabilityDescription: Commitment to producers, communities, and the environment.

Products.title: Our products
Products.description: Discover the diversity and richness of Ecuador's tropical and exotic fruits. We offer a selection of fresh fruits sourced from Ecuadorian growers, designed to meet the needs of international importers, distributors, and buyers.
Products.specsIntro: For each product, we provide technical information according to availability and commercial requirements:
Products.specificDescription: Contact us to learn about our availability, technical specifications, and commercial terms.

About.title: Who we are
About.description: Fruttata Exports is an Ecuadorian company dedicated to exporting tropical and exotic fruits to international markets.
About.body: We are committed to connecting local agricultural production with global business opportunities by offering carefully selected products and promoting business relationships based on trust, transparency, and quality.
About.mission: To connect Ecuador's agricultural excellence with international markets through the export of high-quality tropical and exotic fruits, promoting responsible sourcing, reliable supply chains, and sustainable business relationships with producers and customers.
About.vision: To establish ourselves as a recognized Ecuadorian company in international markets for the export of tropical and exotic fruits, distinguished by product quality, commercial reliability, innovation, and our commitment to sustainable development.

Contact.title: Let's build business opportunities together
Contact.description: Are you an importer, distributor, wholesaler, or professional in the food industry looking for high-quality tropical and exotic fruits? At Fruttata Exports, we will be delighted to assist you.
Contact.body: Our team is available to provide information about our products, availability, technical specifications, and export quotations.
